title: Context and Refs
description: Learn how to share data with context and access DOM elements with refs.
longDescription: Not every value should travel through props. This module teaches React Context for escaping prop drilling, the useContext hook for clean consumption, useRef for DOM access and mutable values, and forwardRef for building flexible component libraries.
whatYouLearn: Identify prop drilling and solve it with createContext
Consume context values cleanly with useContext
Access DOM nodes and persist mutable values across renders with useRef
Forward refs through component boundaries with forwardRef
